description: Build-time relation extraction validation cases for the self-contained synthetic sample-kb fixture (tests/fixtures/sample-kb/). Exercises idBasedOn Domain, Attribute Formula procedure calls, Source procedure calls, Source for-each table navigation, and Table Key/Index extraction on invented Invoice/Customer/Product data. Consumed by Build-KbIntelligenceIndex.py --validation-cases-path.

cases.expectation: idBasedOn Domain:DomId on Attribute InvoiceId must create a based_on_domain relation
idBasedOn Domain:DomId on Attribute CustomerId must create a based_on_domain relation
idBasedOn Domain:DomId on Attribute ProductId must create a based_on_domain relation
CustomerName has no idBasedOn Property, so it must not create a based_on_domain relation
CalculateInvoiceTotal(InvoiceId) inside Property Formula must create an Attribute to Procedure relation
CalculateInvoiceTotal.Call(...) inside WebPanel Source must create a calls_procedure relation
for each Invoice inside Procedure Source must create a navigates_explicit_table relation
Key/Item InvoiceId in Table Invoice must create a Table to Attribute relation
Duplicate Index/Member CustomerId in Table Invoice must create a Table to Attribute relation
Duplicate Index/Member ProductId in Table Invoice must create a Table to Attribute relation
Invoice Level Attribute InvoiceTotal must create a has_level_attribute relation
Level Type="Invoice" on the Invoice transaction must create a has_level_table relation to Table Invoice
